[[File:TanDivowithdroid.png|thumb|right|220px|Detectives [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] and [[LEP-171B/Legends|LEP-171B]]]]
{{Quote|Good man. We'll make a CSF detective of you yet.|Lon Shevu, to Ben Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
A '''detective''', or '''investigator''', was a person who investigated crimes with the intent of solving an open case. Detectives many times worked for a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]].

In the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], Detective was a rank under the [[Chief of Detectives]]. CSF [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] who held a higher rank yet still investigated cases were referred to as [[Inspector/Legends|inspector]] along with their given rank.
